description: UpdatePrivateNIC answers `{"private_nic": {...}}` like CreatePrivateNIC and GetPrivateNIC, but the document declares its 200 as the bare `scaleway.instance.v1.PrivateNIC`, so every member decoded as absent. Observed 2026-10-14 in the live Project: `PATCH /instance/v1/zones/nl-ams-1/servers/{server_id}/private_nics/{private_nic_id}` with `{"tags": ["i"]}` answered 200 `{"private_nic": {"id": …, "private_network_id": …, "server_id": …, "mac_address": …, "state": "available", …}}`.
